title: Yogic Subtle-Body Maps
description: A child of human-anatomy adding chakras, central and paired channels, nāḍī networks, kuṇḍalinī, prāṇa-apāna balance, dvādaśānta ascent and explicit physical-versus-subtle comparison.

assets.description: A luminous central practice-axis joining the root and crown landmarks.
Seven parametrically animated lotus centers anchored to the canonical body coordinate system.
Paired oscillating channels weave around the central axis and carry opposing timed pulses.
A fine branching channel network links axial centers with limbs and extremities.
A coiled root current gradually uncoils and lifts toward the central axis.
An expanding field of ellipses and luminosity opens above the crown coordinate.
provenance: dvadasanta_axis_pack.py: crown opening and external stations

mechanisms.description: Seven lotus centers activate in sequence along a shared contemplative body-axis.
mechanisms.motionProof: Centers activate in ordered relation along one stable axis, turning a list of chakras into a staged practice-map.

mechanisms.description: Paired lateral currents weave around a central channel while timed pulses preserve their difference.
mechanisms.motionProof: Opposed pulses travel through different woven routes around one stable center, making channel coordination visible across time.

mechanisms.description: A coiled root current uncoils and rises through staged centers before opening into a crown field.
mechanisms.motionProof: The root coil changes topology, traverses the stable axis and opens at the crown; the argument is the transformation, not a glowing snake icon.

mechanisms.description: A current rises centrally and returns around the body, preserving cyclic return rather than treating ascent as escape.
mechanisms.motionProof: Multiple pulses complete the full route and visibly return to their origin, distinguishing circulation from one-way ascent.

mechanisms.description: Parallel bodies keep biomedical systems and yogic practice-maps distinct while allowing functional comparison.
mechanisms.motionProof: Physical rhythms and subtle currents animate independently on aligned bodies, revealing possible functional correspondences without merging their ontological status.

mechanisms.description: Twelve named contemplative stations unfold from the heart through bodily, cranial and exterior coordinates.
mechanisms.motionProof: A current reaches each station in strict order and then crosses the body boundary, so the sequence and change of containment are both visible.

mechanisms.description: Descending and ascending currents converge at the navel into a temporary luminous equilibrium.
mechanisms.motionProof: Opposed directional currents visibly approach the same center and reorganise as a larger shared field.

selectionPolicy.captionPolicy: Use short Sanskrit terms or anatomical landmarks as seals, never paragraphs.

selectionPolicy.epistemicRule: Every subtle-body scene must be identified as a textual, contemplative, phenomenological or symbolic model unless the narration explicitly discusses empirical evidence.
